question: How much is the shuttle for the Heron Chain Loop?

hops.text: Your permit must be for the Heron Lake entry point
Heron Lake is the start of the Heron Chain Loop
| Shuttle: EP-14, tow boat | $95 per group, round trip |

notes: Trap 5 and trap 1: route → entry point name → code → rate sheet, which lists shuttles by code only. The 2025 sheet says $80.
